en-US.name: Contract Review Team
en-US.summary: Six-member contract review team with parallel risk and jurisdiction checks, independent re-verification, scored reporting, and tracked DOCX delivery. Requires a user-configured model service; contract text and attachments are sent for analysis, results require qualified human review, and capability gaps produce a bounded report.
en-US.description: Six members collaborate through stable, observable steps: input coverage, source evidence, real receipts, independent re-verification, and explicit gaps. The Lead fans out jurisdiction and risk checks in parallel, then produces a scored report and tracked DOCX. Contract text and attachments are sent to the user-configured model service for analysis; qualified human review remains required, and missing capabilities produce only a bounded report.

zh-CN.name: 合同审查团队
zh-CN.summary: 六名成员协作完成风险与法域并行、独立复核、评分报告和带修订 DOCX 交付。需要用户配置模型服务；合同正文与附件会发送用于分析，结果必须由具备资质的人员复核，能力缺口只生成范围受限报告。
zh-CN.description: 六名成员按固定且可观察的步骤协作：文件覆盖、原文证据、真实回执、独立复核和明确欠账。Lead 将法域与风险检查真正并行，再生成评分报告和带修订 DOCX。合同正文与附件会发送到用户配置的模型服务用于分析；调用前必须确认 provider/model 路由与服务可用性，不可用时停止并只生成 capability_debt/blocked 的范围受限报告，不得伪造法律结论。使用前必须由具备资质的人员复核，服务条款与额外费用由用户负责。

requirements.value: Before any call, confirm the configured provider/model route and service availability. Contract text and attachments are sent to that service; if unavailable, stop and emit only a capability_debt/blocked bounded report, never a fabricated legal result.
Qualified human review is required before using the scored report or tracked DOCX. Provider terms and any separate service costs remain the user's responsibility.
